commitResults.messageTitle: Reject null guardian entries during data loading
commitResults.messageBody:
Validate each persisted guardian entry before converting it to the
domain model. Report a controlled IllegalValueException when a guardian
array contains null instead of allowing a NullPointerException.

Add direct conversion and JSON storage regression tests to verify that
malformed guardian data produces a DataLoadingException during startup.

Summary
Implements student search by name using the find-student n/QUERY command.
The search filters the displayed student list using normalized, case-insensitive substring matching without modifying persisted student data.
Fixes #61

Changes
Added find-student n/QUERY.
Added case-insensitive partial-name and multiword phrase matching.
Added query whitespace and Unicode normalization.
Added a filtered observable student list to the model.
Added appropriate feedback for matching and empty results.
Added validation for missing, repeated, unknown, and invalid parameters.
Added list-students to restore the complete student list.
Preserved permanent student IDs for use with view-student.
Added command, parser, predicate, and model tests.
Testing
Ran .\gradlew.bat check successfully.
Manually verified in the JavaFX application:
Searching find-student n/mei displayed only Mei Lin and Mei Wen.
view-student sid/S-0003 opened the correct search result.
A search with no matches displayed the correct empty state.
An empty query displayed the expected format error.
list-students restored the complete student list.
